spec_text:
Build a Node.js CLI (scripts/healthcheck.mjs) that:
- reads an RPC URL + timeout from env (RPC_URL, TIMEOUT_MS, default 5000)
- calls eth_chainId and eth_blockNumber, measures round-trip latency in ms
- exits 0 on success, exits 1 on any failure (timeout, bad response, no URL)
- prints one JSON line per run: {"chainId":...,"block":...,"latencyMs":...}
Include a unit test (node:test) that mocks the RPC and asserts success + failure paths.
Deliver as a pinned repo: https://github.com/owner/repo@<commit>.
name: RPC health-check cron
